name: Fondation Louis Vuitton

why_flagged: The Cour des comptes (November 2018) said the donations could amount to sponsorship promoting LVMH. Anticor challenged the secrecy of its accounts.
records_note: No annual reports, accounts, donor list or board found; the Conseil d'Etat ruled in 2022 that its accounts cannot be released to third parties.

name: Louvre
watch: Sackler name came off in July 2019, after a PAIN protest; the Louvre cites a 20-year limit. Total faced a 2017 campaign here.
why_flagged: 2025 patron lists name Deloitte, DS Automobiles, Bloomberg, CMA CGM, EDF, Stellantis, Dior and Louis Vuitton. TotalEnergies funded exhibitions for two decades; the Louvre says no direct partnership since 2018.
records_note: The Louvre posts activity reports for 2018 to 2025, a named 2025 donor list, and its 19-member board; no separate accounts page was found.
other_findings: WikiLeaks, 2010-01: Prince Sultan bin Salman told the US ambassador that Saudi Arabia's heritage campaign would open with a Louvre show, Roads of Arabia (2010). Saudi cables show the cabinet praising it. (Cablegate 10RIYADH31; Saudi Cables) | WikiLeaks, c. 2011: A Fars News item forwarded in Stratfor's emails says Iran froze cooperation with the Louvre over a reciprocal show it says was promised for 2009–10. (Stratfor emails (Fars News item))

name: Musée d'Orsay
watch: A September 2025 analysis says taxpayers bore about 90% of LVMH's gift. Epstein's 2012 visit and Leon Black's 2014 loan are not flagged.
why_flagged: A September 2025 analysis says taxpayers bore about 90% of LVMH's gift. Epstein's 2012 visit and Leon Black's 2014 loan are not flagged.
records_note: Activity reports 2006 to 2025 with an aggregated income statement are on the EPMO site, patrons are undated logo clouds, and the board is listed.
other_findings: Epstein link · Jeffrey Epstein · documented: In an 18 March 2012 email in the DOJ's January 2026 release, Epstein wrote that "the govt is going to open the musee dorsay for me and woody alien at 4", "alien" being his typo for Woody Allen. He later bragged about the visit in emails, including one to Eva Dubin. The Musée d'Orsay did not respond to ARTnews and has not confirmed the visit. | Epstein link · Leon Black · documented: Black lent his Van Gogh "Quarry near Saint-Rémy", valued at $60 million in 2016, to the Orsay's 2014 show "Van Gogh/Artaud: Le Suicidé de la Société". The Art Newspaper reports that the Epstein files indicate his Van Goghs were collateral for large bank loans around 2016. Epstein gave Black "extensive financial advice" for fees of at least $158 million, and Black denies wrongdoing and says he knew nothing of Epstein's crimes until 2019.

name: Kochi-Muziris Biennale
watch: In December 2022, 47 artists and six collectives published an open letter citing poor communication and opaque finances. Founder Bose Krishnamachari resigned in January 2026.
why_flagged: Funded by Kerala state grants and private donors. Its 2025-26 site names no sponsors; a December 2025 headline records philanthropist Minal Bajaj's support.
records_note: Kochi-Muziris Biennale names benefactors, patrons and supporters for its 2025 edition and lists ten trustees, but posts no annual report or accounts.

name: Kiran Nadar Museum of Art
watch: In July 2023 it fired Sandip K Luis over a post criticising Nadar's role in a state exhibition. Shahidul Alam pulled his show.
why_flagged: Private museum founded and chaired by collector Kiran Nadar, free to visit. Its home page names no funders.
records_note: KNMA posts FCRA financial statements for 2014-15 to 2024-25 and lists its trustees and advisers, but no annual report or donor list.
